summary: I registered the retrieval thinker under the dispatcher and verified it live: a duplicate observation was suppressed and a fresh reminder was emitted. Later I confirmed the registration persisted even after a wakeup (active_thinkers still lists retrieval and dispatch fired at 16:36:11), though I noted the dispatcher pid was stale and active_thinkers should be rechecked after any restart. I also captured a port datum: the wake clock is externally owned by a host-side dispatcher, making thinkers passive subscribers with trigger_self:false and exponential backoff.
